SessionStart.description: Inject METHODOLOGY.md doctrine (decision-sizing triad + reasoning scaffold) into session context
Bridge hook-only ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} into the session as ${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT} so command markdown (no official ${CLAUDE_COMMAND_DIR}) can reference bundled scripts portably

Advisory: surface memory-lint findings (dangling links, orphans, index drift) at session start, plus an UNINDEXED fold-vs-forgotten triage when applicable — silent when clean; restores the surfacing loop dropped in the 2026-06-27 reset

UserPromptSubmit.description: Advisory: when user prompt looks like non-trivial engineering work, nudge mattpocock-skills:grilling → mattpocock-skills:to-spec → mattpocock-skills:to-tickets → /ship
Advisory: when user prompt mentions Jira/Confluence/TP-* work, nudge routing through jira-acli's skills before any raw acli command or direct Atlassian MCP tool call. Never blocks.

PreToolUse.description: Gate: block irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, push --force, --no-verify, reset --hard, clean -f)

Gate: ask the human to approve edits to BOTH non-model verifiers — hooks/gates/** + hooks/advisory/** + hooks/hooks.json (deny-gates + advisory sensors + wiring) AND skills/harness-audit/scripts/audit.sh + checks/** (audit grader). Tamper-resistance: the model cannot edit the code that judges it. Emits permissionDecision: ask (no env-var bypass). Also folds the former path-hardcode deny (blocks hardcoded /Users/<name> in .sh/.py, exit 2 before the ask — block wins) since 2026-07-03; one fewer python3 spawn per Write/Edit. NotebookEdit added 2026-08-06 (the script already read notebook_path; the matcher just never granted it), matching gate:write:worktree-guard's coverage.
Gate: ask the human to approve Bash-mediated writes (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp, mv) to verifier surfaces — closes the Write/Edit matcher's blind spot. Emits permissionDecision: ask.

Gate: ask on non-SELECT execute_sql-shaped MCP calls, on any server. Restores coverage lost when hooks/db-write-gate.sh was deleted in the v0.6.0 reset. No-op when no such MCP server is configured (matcher never fires).

Gate: a subagent may not mark its own task completed (maker≠checker). Only the main session completes tasks; validator subagents return verdicts to main. Denies TaskUpdate(status=completed) when agent_type is present (subagent). Exit 2 + stderr; fail-safe allow on parse error.

Marks the session jira-acli-engaged when a jira-acli:* skill loads (writes ~/.local/share/kbg/jira-acli-sessions/<session_id>), so the companion gate:mcp:atlassian-cold-start gate can allow-list it. Never blocks Skill itself.

Gate: block a direct Atlassian/Jira/Confluence MCP call (mcp__*atlassian*/mcp__*rovo*, both a local/plugin MCP server and a claude.ai connector) before a jira-acli:* skill loaded this session -- forces routing through jira-acli's templates instead of a cold MCP call. Cold-start guard, not a per-call router: allows every later call once the session is marked engaged (confluence-content's page create/update and acli's own 'When acli can't' fallback list legitimately use this same MCP). Escape: KBG_ALLOW_DIRECT_ATLASSIAN_MCP=1.

Gate: redirect Edit/Write on a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch into a session worktree under ~/.worktrees (base branch via KBG_WORKTREE_BASE, e.g. =main for hotfix). Opt-in and off by default: no-op everywhere unless KBG_GUARDED_WORKSPACE is set (this is a public plugin — no workspace path ships in code). Moved from dotfiles 2026-07-02. Bash early-exit (2026-07-03): when the var is unset or CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is known and outside the guarded workspace, skip the python3 cold-start entirely and exit 0 — this gate is a no-op there anyway; only the guarded path spawns python.

hooks.command: bash -c 'w="${KBG_GUARDED_WORKSPACE:-}"; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [[ -z "$w" || ( "$w" == /* && -n "$p" && "$p" != "$w" && "$p" != "$w/"* ) ]]; then exit 0; fi; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gates/worktree-guard.py"'

PreToolUse.description: Gate: deny (not redirect) a Bash-mediated write (echo >>, sed -i, tee, cp/mv, …) that targets a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch. Same protection as gate:write:worktree-guard's Write/Edit path, ported to Bash 2026-07-16 — the Write/Edit matcher never saw a Bash-mediated write, mirroring the gap verifier-protect.sh closed on 2026-07-03. Denies instead of redirecting: a raw shell command's target can't be rewritten via updatedInput the way file_path can. Opt-in and off by default: no-op everywhere unless KBG_GUARDED_WORKSPACE is set.

hooks.command: bash -c 'w="${KBG_GUARDED_WORKSPACE:-}"; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [[ -z "$w" || ( "$w" == /* && -n "$p" && "$p" != "$w" && "$p" != "$w/"* ) ]]; then exit 0; fi; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gates/worktree-guard.py"'

PostToolUse.description: Advisory: after a plan is approved, nudge dispatching kbg:plan-reviewer for consequential plans before implementing. Never blocks.

Advisory: after a git commit, if a plan was approved earlier this session, remind the model to tell the user they can run /kbg:compliance-audit themselves (disable-model-invocation:true — never dispatch it). Never blocks.

Stop.description: Stop: track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl

Stop: if the current project's memory store is already a git repo (opt-in, one-time user-run `git init` — this hook never inits it), commit any dirty changes for a real audit trail / rollback path. No-op otherwise.

Stop: if a task this session created via TaskCreate still shows status in_progress with no TaskUpdate call for it since, nudge the model via additionalContext before the turn ends. Synchronous (not async) — additionalContext from an async hook only lands next turn, too late to matter. Deduped to one nudge per task per session via a marker file; never fires on stop_hook_active to avoid re-triggering itself.

SessionEnd.description: Advisory: remind the operator that kbg:learn exists when the session had enough activity (transcript user-turn count) to plausibly contain a durable learning. Never blocks — SessionEnd has no decision control. Emits to stderr (SessionEnd stdout is discarded; stderr is shown to the user).
